regions.label: InesHeader
regions.evidence: Validated iNES magic, PRG count 2 x16 KiB, CHR count 4 x8 KiB, mapper 1, no trainer. workspace.json inspection and run.py inspect.

regions.label: CpuInterruptVectors
regions.evidence: Three little-endian CPU vectors NMI $DEE5, reset $FFDD, IRQ $DF24; inspected decoder and reset observation establish effective PRG slots [0,1,2,3].

regions.label: ChrPatternBanks
regions.evidence: Header-declared CHR ROM backing, separate from CPU PRG address space. Eight 4 KiB MMC1 CHR pages contain NES planar 8x8 tile patterns; startup framebuffer visibly displays tile fonts/logos. Boundaries independently fixed by cartridge section sizes; no CPU code claim.
